focus: Rwanda tax-benefit surface: employment income tax (PAYE) and the lump-sum regime, rental income tax, RSSB contributions (pension, occupational hazards, maternity leave, and the RAMA and MMI medical schemes), community-based health insurance (CBHI) contributions, VAT, excise duty, and the VUP Direct Support, school feeding, Girinka and fuel-subsidy programmes.

national.description: Rwanda is a unitary state. All encoded laws, orders and programme rules live under the single national rw/ namespace; there is no regional layer.

purpose: Machine-readable map from Rwanda tax-benefit tracks to their governing instruments, the RuleSpec modules that encode them and the RWAMOD comparison suites that check them. Amounts, rates and thresholds live in the modules, not here.
source_priority: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda prints (trilingual Kinyarwanda/English/French; the English text is citable), served as gazette PDFs by amategeko.gov.rw and the Ministry of Justice portal; gazette-facsimile mirrors are acceptable when the portal does not serve the print, recorded with the host in manifest metadata.
Presidential, Prime Minister's and Ministerial Orders implementing the laws.
Rwanda Revenue Authority guidance and programme manuals only after the governing instrument is identified.
RWAMOD (SOUTHMOD A4.0) as a pinned household-level comparison reference for parity tests: supporting only, never legal authority.

current_blockers.description: No module carries an encoding manifest and the generated guard is off, so no module is attested supervised-encoder output.
The active validation waiver for the pension contribution-rate module expires on 2026-10-14; from then validate fails until the module passes and the waiver is removed in the same change.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 establishing taxes on income, Article 56 (withholding tax on employment income, including the casual-labourer special rate); tax period under Article 8 and commencement under Article 73.
tracks.agency_surface: Rwanda Revenue Authority PAYE guidance, only after the governing article is identified.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 establishing taxes on income, Article 3 (small and micro-enterprise definitions), Article 14 (lump-sum tax and the micro-enterprise flat-amount table) and Article 21 (agricultural and livestock income exemption).
Law No 048/2023 of 05/09/2023 on the revenue of decentralised entities, Article 43 (taxable rental income) and Article 42 (rental income tax schedule).
Presidential Order No 086/01 of 12/12/2024, Article One (mandatory pension scheme contribution rate), shared equally between employer and employee under Law No 05/2015 of 30/03/2015, Article 8.
tracks.note: Also imported by the composed disposable-income pipeline. Its active validation waiver expires on 2026-10-14 (rulespec-rw#18 item 4).

tracks.primary_source: Law No 06/2003 modifying the Decree-Law of 22 August 1974, Articles 9 and 10: an employer-paid branch whose rate is delegated to a Presidential Decree (per axiom-oracles ledger entry rwamod-occupational-hazards-rate-not-digitized).
tracks.note: The rate-fixing Presidential Decree is not publicly digitized, so no encodable carrier is captured.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 003/2016 of 30/03/2016 establishing and governing the maternity leave benefits scheme, Article 7; contribution base under Ministerial Order No 007/16/10/TC of 28/10/2016, Article 6.
tracks.note: Also imported by the composed disposable-income pipeline.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 24/2001 on the RAMA medical insurance scheme, Article 44 as amended by Law No 29/2002 of 19/09/2002 (captured from the RSSB library English consolidated print).
tracks.note: Covers employer and employee contributions on the employee's basic salary; the captured print carries no provision on contributions by retired members.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 23/2005 of 12/12/2005 on Military Medical Insurance, Article 30. Law No 036/2022 of 09/12/2022 replaces it and defers the rates to a Prime Minister's Order that is not publicly digitized.
Ministerial Order No 002/26/10/TC of 16/02/2026, Article One (CBHI member contribution by IMIBEREHO Dynamic Social Registry level); in force on publication, 23/02/2026 (Article 5).
tracks.note: This Order is the first gazetted carrier of the member premium schedule, so no gazetted instrument carries it in CY2025 (axiom-oracles ledger rwamod-cbhi-tier-premiums-gazetting-timing).

tracks.primary_source: Prime Minister's Order No 105/03 of 30/09/2020, Article 5 (formal-sector employee CBHI contribution on net salary); repealed with effect from 23/02/2026 by Prime Minister's Order No 001/03 of 16/02/2026, whose Article 5 is not yet encoded.
tracks.note: No suite compares this module: rw-dispy's levy comparison tests the composed pipeline's own copy of the rate (rulespec-rw#18 items 2 and 3).

tracks.primary_source: Law No 03/2015 on community-based health insurance, Articles 8, 14, 15, 17, 19, 23 to 25 and 27 (membership waiting and grace periods, funding, mobilisation committees, deadlines, administrative fines and transition).
Law No 049/2023 of 05/09/2023 on value added tax, Article 3 (charge) and Article 4 (rates).
tracks.agency_surface: Rwanda Revenue Authority VAT guidance, only after the governing article is identified.

tracks.primary_source: Law No 011/2025 of 27/05/2025 establishing excise duty, Article 4 and its Annex.

Composed from Law No 027/2022 Article 56, Presidential Order No 086/01 with Law No 05/2015 Article 8, Law No 003/2016 Article 7, and Prime Minister's Order No 105/03 Article 5 applied to the composed net salary.
tracks.note: In the scope of the CY2025 income-tax program spec (rw/programs/income-tax/cy-2025.yaml). The pipeline is not yet a module.kind composition and redefines the levy rate (rulespec-rw#18 item 2); the levy rests on a repealed Order for 2026 periods (item 3).

tracks.primary_source: Vision 2020 Umurenge Programme (VUP) Operational Manual (LODA, FY2024/25), section 1.1.4: the Direct Support household entitlement table, set administratively; no gazetted instrument fixes it.
MINEDUC National School Feeding Programme rules, set administratively.
MINAGRI Girinka programme rules, set administratively.
Petroleum pricing instruments that set fuel subsidies administratively.
